REQUIREMENTS.LABEL: a label

INPUTS.NO_LABELS: This account has no labels yet.
INPUTS.ORDERS: More than this many visible orders

AUDIENCE.TITLE: Start from an audience preset
AUDIENCE.DESCRIPTION: A preset saves a normal audience: its conditions stay editable and its members are worked out fresh every time it is opened.

HIGH_VALUE_BUYERS.NAME: High-value buyers
HIGH_VALUE_BUYERS.DESCRIPTION: Contacts whose visible spend in one currency is above an amount you choose. Spend is never converted between currencies.

REPEAT_BUYERS.NAME: Repeat buyers
REPEAT_BUYERS.DESCRIPTION: Contacts with more than a given number of visible orders.

RECENT_BUYERS.NAME: Recent buyers
RECENT_BUYERS.DESCRIPTION: Contacts whose last visible purchase was within the last few days.

CUSTOMERS_WITH_ACTIVE_ORDER.NAME: Customers with an open order
CUSTOMERS_WITH_ACTIVE_ORDER.DESCRIPTION: Contacts who have at least one order that is not finished yet.

CUSTOMERS_WITH_SHIPPED_ORDER.NAME: Customers with a shipped order
CUSTOMERS_WITH_SHIPPED_ORDER.DESCRIPTION: Contacts with an order the store has marked shipped.

STORE_CUSTOMERS.NAME: Customers of one store
STORE_CUSTOMERS.DESCRIPTION: Contacts linked to a customer in the store you choose.

LINKED_COMMERCE_CUSTOMERS.NAME: All linked customers
LINKED_COMMERCE_CUSTOMERS.DESCRIPTION: Contacts linked to a customer in any connected store.

CONTACTED_US.NAME: Has contacted us
CONTACTED_US.DESCRIPTION: Contacts who have at least one conversation, in any status. Membership is worked out fresh every time, so it is never out of date.

NEVER_CONTACTED_US.NAME: Has never contacted us
NEVER_CONTACTED_US.DESCRIPTION: Contacts with no conversation at all — the people an imported list is usually meant to reach.

FLOW.TITLE: Start from a flow template
FLOW.DESCRIPTION: A template creates a normal flow draft: every node, message and branch is yours to edit, and nothing reaches a customer until you publish it.

COMMERCE_ORDER_TRACKING.NAME: Order tracking bot
COMMERCE_ORDER_TRACKING.DESCRIPTION: Offers to track an order, finds the customer's own latest order, asks for an order number when there is none, and hands anything else to your team.
COMMERCE_ORDER_TRACKING.PROVIDER_NOTE: WooCommerce, Zid and Shopify can find an order by its number. Salla cannot, so on a Salla store the customer reaches your team instead. Delivery tracking detail also differs by platform.

COMMERCE_AFTER_SALES.NAME: Order issue intake
COMMERCE_AFTER_SALES.DESCRIPTION: Asks for the order number, finds the order, asks what went wrong, and hands the conversation over with the answer already noted.
COMMERCE_AFTER_SALES.PROVIDER_NOTE: WooCommerce, Zid and Shopify can find an order by its number. Salla cannot, so on a Salla store the customer reaches your team instead.

SUPPORT_DEPARTMENT_ROUTING.NAME: Department routing bot
SUPPORT_DEPARTMENT_ROUTING.DESCRIPTION: Asks which topic the customer needs, acknowledges the choice, and hands the conversation to the team you mapped to it.

VIP_PRIORITY_ROUTING.NAME: VIP priority routing
VIP_PRIORITY_ROUTING.DESCRIPTION: Checks whether the contact is in a shared audience, then sends them to your dedicated team or to the standard one.

BILINGUAL_WELCOME.NAME: Arabic or English welcome
BILINGUAL_WELCOME.DESCRIPTION: Asks which language the customer prefers, replies in that language, and routes them to the team that speaks it. No language detection.

WHATSAPP_WELCOME_MENU.NAME: Welcome and collect the request
WHATSAPP_WELCOME_MENU.DESCRIPTION: Greets the customer, asks what they need, confirms it has been received, and hands the conversation to your team with the request in view.

FAQ_MENU.NAME: The questions you answer every day
FAQ_MENU.DESCRIPTION: A menu of your most-asked questions with an answer for each, a way back to the menu, and the team one tap away. Every answer is yours to edit.

COMPLAINT_INTAKE.NAME: A complaint arrives sorted
COMPLAINT_INTAKE.DESCRIPTION: Takes the complaint in the customer’s own words, labels the conversation so you can count them later, asks what kind it is, and hands it to a team at the priority you choose.

AUTOMATION.TITLE: Start from an automation recipe
AUTOMATION.DESCRIPTION: A recipe creates a normal automation rule, switched off, for you to read and change before it runs.

COMMERCE_ABANDONED_CART_TEMPLATE.NAME: Abandoned cart gets an approved WhatsApp template
COMMERCE_ABANDONED_CART_TEMPLATE.DESCRIPTION: When a store reports a cart abandoned, send the customer an approved WhatsApp template. The rule is created switched off: choose the WhatsApp inbox, the approved template and its variables in the rule, then turn it on.
COMMERCE_ABANDONED_CART_TEMPLATE.PROVIDER_NOTE: Only Zid reports abandoned carts to Lynomia, and cart ingestion is still being verified against a real Zid store, so this rule will not run yet even once you switch it on.

COMMERCE_NEW_ORDER_ROUTING.NAME: New order goes to a team
COMMERCE_NEW_ORDER_ROUTING.DESCRIPTION: When a store records a new order, label the customer's conversation and assign it to the team that handles orders.

COMMERCE_ORDER_SHIPPED_LABEL.NAME: Label a shipped order
COMMERCE_ORDER_SHIPPED_LABEL.DESCRIPTION: When a store marks an order shipped, add a label to the customer's conversation so your team can see it at a glance.
COMMERCE_ORDER_SHIPPED_LABEL.PROVIDER_NOTE: Salla, Zid and Shopify report an order as shipped. WooCommerce has no shipped status, so this rule will not run for a WooCommerce store.

COMMERCE_REFUND_ESCALATION.NAME: Refund gets escalated
COMMERCE_REFUND_ESCALATION.DESCRIPTION: When an order is refunded, raise the conversation's priority and send it to the team that handles refunds.

COMMERCE_EVENT_WEBHOOK.NAME: Send an order event to another system
COMMERCE_EVENT_WEBHOOK.DESCRIPTION: When the order event you choose happens, call an address of yours with the existing webhook action.

VIP_AUDIENCE_PRIORITY.NAME: Audience gets priority
VIP_AUDIENCE_PRIORITY.DESCRIPTION: When someone in a shared audience starts a conversation, set its priority and send it to your dedicated team.

HIGH_VALUE_SPEND_ROUTING.NAME: High-value customer routing
HIGH_VALUE_SPEND_ROUTING.DESCRIPTION: When someone whose visible spend in one currency is above an amount you choose starts a conversation, route it to a team of your choice.

ACTIVE_ORDER_ROUTING.NAME: Customer with an open order
ACTIVE_ORDER_ROUTING.DESCRIPTION: When someone who has an order still in progress starts a conversation, send it to the team that can answer about it.

COMMERCE_ORDER_PAID_PRIORITY.NAME: A paid order moves up the queue
COMMERCE_ORDER_PAID_PRIORITY.DESCRIPTION: When a customer's order is paid for, label the conversation and raise its priority so the order is handled before the questions.

COMMERCE_ORDER_CANCELLED_FOLLOWUP.NAME: Someone follows up a cancelled order
COMMERCE_ORDER_CANCELLED_FOLLOWUP.DESCRIPTION: When an order is cancelled, send the conversation to a team with a note asking them to find out why. The customer is never messaged automatically.
COMMERCE_ORDER_CANCELLED_FOLLOWUP.PROVIDER_NOTE: WooCommerce, Salla and Zid report an order as cancelled. Shopify does not, so this rule will not run for a Shopify store.

GREET_NEW_CONVERSATION.NAME: Every new conversation gets an answer
GREET_NEW_CONVERSATION.DESCRIPTION: When someone starts a conversation, reply at once so they know they have been heard. Edit the wording before you turn it on.

AUDIENCE_CONVERSATION_LABEL.NAME: An audience’s conversations are labelled
AUDIENCE_CONVERSATION_LABEL.DESCRIPTION: When someone in a shared audience starts a conversation, label it — so the group you described can be found in the inbox and in reports.

MACRO.TITLE: Start from a macro starter
MACRO.DESCRIPTION: A starter saves a normal macro: an agent clicks it on a conversation and it runs the steps. Everything stays editable, and nothing runs on its own.

ESCALATE_CONVERSATION.NAME: Escalate this conversation
ESCALATE_CONVERSATION.DESCRIPTION: Raises the priority, hands it to a team, labels it, and leaves a note for whoever picks it up.

TAKE_CONVERSATION.NAME: I'll take this one
TAKE_CONVERSATION.DESCRIPTION: Assigns the conversation to whoever clicks it and sets a normal priority. Needs nothing set up first.

RESOLVE_WITH_REASON.NAME: Resolve with a reason
RESOLVE_WITH_REASON.DESCRIPTION: Labels the conversation with the reason it was closed, then resolves it, so the resolved queue can be read later.

HAND_TO_TEAM.NAME: Hand to a team
HAND_TO_TEAM.DESCRIPTION: Moves the conversation to a team, clears the current assignee, and leaves a note with the context.

WAITING_ON_CUSTOMER.NAME: Waiting on the customer
WAITING_ON_CUSTOMER.DESCRIPTION: Labels the conversation and snoozes it, so it comes back instead of sitting in the open queue.

STORE_ISSUE_HANDOFF.NAME: Send a store question to the right team
STORE_ISSUE_HANDOFF.DESCRIPTION: Labels an order or store question, raises its priority and routes it to the team that can open the store. A macro cannot read or change an order itself.

SETUP.TITLE: Set up more than one thing at once
SETUP.PARTIAL: Only part of this was created: {created}. Nothing else was changed — finish the rest yourself, or delete it and try again.

SPEND_AUDIENCE_ROUTING.NAME: Your best customers reach a dedicated team
SPEND_AUDIENCE_ROUTING.DESCRIPTION: Creates two things: a shared audience of the customers who have spent more than you say, and a rule that sends their conversations to a team at the priority you choose. Both stay yours to edit, and the rule arrives switched off.
SPEND_AUDIENCE_ROUTING.RULE_NAME: High-value customers reach a dedicated team
